Title: Public preview: Azure Cost Management + Billing’s cost allocation now available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
Cost allocation’s availability in Azure Government can assist federal, state, and local governments and federal departments and agencies in creating rules to allocate the costs of shared services within their organization.

Learn more about Azure Cost Management’s cost allocation.
